name: E2E core 1066: where prompts live
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'where in LangWatch can I see my prompts?'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy tells the user where prompts live in the product (naming the Prompts section/page).
Langy does not respond with vague 'go to settings' instructions.
Langy does not ask which project.
The reply contains no worker-side address: no localhost, no 127.0.0.1, no container port, no raw environment-variable placeholder standing in for a host.
